http/client_request#

A request checked before it leaves: an absolute http or https URL and at most one Host, matching it.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

A request checked before it leaves: an absolute http or https URL and at most one Host, matching it. HttpClient uses it. A body its fields do not frame is framed for HTTP/1.1 here: Content-Length when its length is known and not 0, Transfer-Encoding: chunked when it is not known; it is never read for that.

Public API#

object HttpDirectRequest

Prepare an ordinary direct request before DNS or socket effects. CONNECT and OPTIONS * require separate explicitly routed consumers.
